snapshot_control.status: source contract prepared; not native evidence or CI activation

coverage.IDLE: all manual events one thread; pin-read=1, snapshot-closed/connection-closed/idle-ready before first save
coverage.HELD_SNAPSHOT: all manual events one thread; pin-read=1; hold-enter<=first save; last save<=hold-exit; pin-recheck=1; then snapshot-closed/connection-closed
coverage.ACTIVE_SEARCH: one original read; snapshot-open<=page-hits-start<=active-ready<=first save; last save<=page-hits-end<=snapshot-closed<=read-end; stronger than whole-read lifetime, early query completion is invalid and never retried

snapshot_control.wholeMethod: all three arm blocks in order, each complete=true/coverageValid=true/30 committed, zero dropped and invalid=false; otherwise invalid diagnostic, no retry/loop
